name: Pocket
author: jrmmhm
description: Hide the bar widgets you rarely use behind one mark and reveal them on hover — a drawer that declutters a crowded bar. Drag a widget onto the mark to tuck it away, drag it back past it to take it out. Call it folding, grouping, collapse or overflow. Nothing moves: the hidden icons keep their own bar slots and settings, and stay enabled.

barWidget.description: Hides the bar widgets you drag onto it and shows them again while the pointer is on them

schema.label: Widget ids to tuck away, comma separated
schema.description: Usually set by dragging widgets onto the pocket. Edit it here to name them by hand.

schema.label: Screens it stays open on, comma separated
schema.description: Usually set by left-clicking the pocket on that screen. A laptop panel is named by its connector (eDP-1), any other screen by its model (ASUS VG289).

schema.label: Screens it stays shut on, comma separated
schema.description: Keeps the pocket closed there when the pointer passes over it. Usually set by right-clicking the pocket on that screen. Screens are named as for the setting above.
